title: AHB5 Exclusive Success and Failure
description: Compare two conditional read-modify-write attempts: the bus remains available in both, but only an unchanged monitored location permits the exclusive write to update memory.

phases.name: Exclusive read
phases.description: HEXCL=1 and HTRANS=NONSEQ. The monitor records the address, attributes, and unique HMASTER identity.

phases.name: Bus remains free
phases.description: The initiating master performs local work; no global ownership lock is held.

phases.name: Exclusive write
phases.description: The matching exclusive write reaches a location that has remained unchanged.

phases.name: HEXOKAY=1
phases.description: The monitor reports success and the write updates memory.

phases.name: Exclusive read
phases.description: A second attempt establishes its own monitor state.

phases.name: Bus remains free
phases.description: Other traffic is allowed because this is not a locked sequence.

phases.name: Exclusive write
phases.description: The master attempts the matching conditional write after interference.

phases.name: HEXOKAY=0
phases.description: The monitor reports failure and memory is not updated. This conditional failure is distinct from HRESP ERROR.

phases.name: Writes monitored location
phases.description: A write changes the location observed by the failed attempt, invalidating its monitor condition.
